_comment: audiocpp_server config for llama-swap model 'yue2-3b'. models[].id MUST equal the llama-swap model id (the server rejects a mismatched 'model' field). CLI --port from llama-swap overrides 'port' below. AR decode graph arena raised to 256 MiB (family default 32) so songs up to 300s / 7500 semantic frames can allocate the decode graph; below that audio.cpp returns HTTP 500 'failed to allocate QwenCausalDecodeRuntime batched decode graph'.

default_request_options.style: English, warm lead vocal, acoustic pop, gentle drums
